Eligibility

The source says candidates should possess solid analytical skills and MIS reporting capabilities, including data validation, trend analysis, and creation of periodic dashboards and reports. Proficiency in MS Excel, spreadsheets, and basic data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar is highly beneficial. A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Business, or related field is preferred. Prior experience in an MIS, data analysis, or reporting role, especially within assessment, education, or HR domains, will be an advantage. Attention to detail, ability to work with large data sets, and strong organizational skills are important.
